name: Fitchburg & Leominster State Forests
state_or_region: Massachusetts (Fitchburg, Townsend, Westminster & Princeton — with Pearl Hill, Willard Brook & Crow Hills)
summary: Rolling hemlock and pine woods, brooks and ponds north of Fitchburg: Pearl Hill, Table Rock, Trap Falls and a dense web of shared hiking and mountain-bike trails, linked by the Midstate Trail to Leominster State Forest and the Crow Hill Ledges.
